items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: That’s the only time I saw Monk, and it’s the only time I saw a concert at U of R.

ctx.x: Yeah. That’s the only time I saw Monk, and it’s the only time I saw a concert at U of R. I thought it was great. I think it was probably 1972 or something like that, or maybe a tad earlier. But I can at least say I saw Monk. I mean there’s a lot of other guys, having been born when I was, that I never did get a chance to see.

Yeah. What drew you to jazz and the string bass? I mean you could have been attracted to rock & roll more than jazz, or the electric bass, or did you do all that too? © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -2-
